_comment: Canonical P1-P8 end-user personas + the controls each is operationally responsible for. Source: docs/tenant-tests/END-USER-USE-CASES.md. Consumed by the EO persona projection and any persona-facing view. Control ids are full CMMC L2 ids.

personas.title: CUI Engineer
personas.description: Core workforce; full CUI access; engineering/manufacturing on managed devices.

personas.title: Program Manager / Contracts
personas.description: Full CUI access plus heavy external collaboration with primes and the government.

personas.title: Business staff (finance/HR)
personas.description: No CUI access; must be excluded from CUI systems and channels.

personas.title: New hire (onboarding)
personas.description: Access pending screening + initial training; identity being provisioned.

personas.title: Departing employee (offboarding)
personas.description: Offboarding target; access being revoked; sessions terminated.

personas.title: Client IT admin / owner-operator
personas.description: Privileged Day-2 admin via AdminOps with PIM elevation; runs oversight.

personas.title: External partner / guest
personas.description: Constrained; no standing CUI access; B2B/guest with tight boundaries.

personas.title: Remote / traveling worker
personas.description: Off-site; same access as P1/P2 with conditional-access gates.
